name: Documentation and Knowledge Sharing
description: Create and maintain comprehensive documentation including API references, architecture diagrams, runbooks, and onboarding guides. Share knowledge through code comments, wikis, and team sessions.

name: Security Implementation
description: Apply OWASP top-10 mitigations, enforce least-privilege access, conduct threat modelling, and ensure secrets management aligns with organisational security standards.

name: Requirement Analysis
description: Analyse business requirements, define acceptance criteria, break features into deliverable tasks, and validate that implementation aligns with stakeholder expectations.

name: Team Collaboration and Mentoring
description: Foster a collaborative culture through pair programming, code reviews, knowledge-transfer sessions, and mentoring junior team members.

name: Code Quality and Reviews
description: Enforce coding standards, conduct thorough peer reviews, and use static analysis tools to maintain a high-quality, maintainable codebase.

name: Comprehensive Testing
description: Design and implement unit, integration, E2E, and regression test suites. Maintain test coverage thresholds and ensure all CI pipelines include automated test gates.

name: Performance Optimisation
description: Profile application performance, identify bottlenecks, and apply optimisations at code, database, network, and infrastructure levels.

name: CI/CD Pipeline Management
description: Design, implement, and maintain automated build, test, and deployment pipelines to support continuous delivery and rapid feedback loops.

name: Incident Response and Root Cause Analysis
description: Lead or support production incident triage, root cause analysis, and post-incident reviews. Implement preventive measures to reduce mean time to recovery.

name: Compliance and Governance
description: Ensure solutions meet regulatory, audit, and governance requirements. Maintain traceability between requirements and delivered artefacts.
